page.overview:
What is Anorith?

Anorith is based on an ancient ocean-dwelling creature from the cambrian era called anomalocaris. It uses the fins on its back to propel itself through the seas. It has one pair of large eyes, and a pair of claws that eventually would become a Claw Fossil found in the Hoenn region. Small eyes also appear to stick out of its face. The eight wings along Anorith's body wave in sequence to propel it lives.

Anorith has the abilities Swift Swim and Battle Armor. Battle Armor prevents Anorith from being stuck by critical hits, while Swift Swim increases Anorith's speed when it's raining. They are known to live in the prehistoric times of the Pokémon era, and they grab their prey on the sea floor with their sharp claws.

Anorith evolves into Armaldo starting at level 40.

Anorith appears in the anime episode Where's Armaldo? where it, along with other prehistoric Pokémon, were being studied. Many Anorith appear in Wild In The Streets! where they were resurrected by scientists.
